content.title: Chinese Tech Stocks Stumble Amid Sluggish Sentiment
content.summary: Chinese chip and tech stocks stumbled as the negative sentiment on Wall Street carried over into Monday's session. "Hong Kong tech is getting hit from both sides—Wall Street's AI hangover is dampening global appetite for growth names, and weak China data is reminding investors that the domestic demand story still isn't healing," Saxo Markets chief investment strategist Charu Chanana said in an email.
